opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum of £10,000 and a maximum of £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers who coordinates the visit; some specialist arts institutions permitted.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research within the UK.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK institutions of higher education, and on a trial basis UK-based independent research institutes/organisations.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project. Two-stage scheme; the detailed application stage is open for invited applicants (the outline stage is paused and will be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026).
discipline_tags: All subjects in Trust remit except medical/clinical research

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Trust contributes 100% of salary up to £56,000 in year one and 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three; up to £6,000 per annum research expenses; approximately 145 Fellowships available in 2027

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate by take-up; tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research during a 3-year fellowship held at a UK university.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships

amount.raw: minimum value of £3,000 and a maximum of £24,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post; live in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks per year; established record of research.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: The maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship; resident in the UK; permanent member of the UK scholarly community.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, particularly those prevented by routine duties from completing a programme of original research.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million is available for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers; single university or collaboration.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship (Leverhulme Centenary Research Centres round).

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career scholars at lecturer level or equivalent with a permanent academic appointment at a UK university, or nominated by a UK university that undertakes to offer a contract for the award duration.
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem (Centenary Research Leadership Awards round).
